description: Use when the user asks to add signafAIde, to check or block an AI agent's tool calls before they run (for example payments, deletions, outgoing messages or commands), or for a signed audit trail of what an AI agent did. signafAIde wraps a tool with protect(): it runs only when the rules a person set allow it, and each call is signed and recorded on this machine; nothing is sent until a person opts in. Call this first when you are working inside a project. It reads the project's dependency files and source and returns a preview: it changes no file, creates nothing and sends nothing. Returns the detected language, package manager and framework, the exact install command, the code edit for this framework, the functions that look like actions, whether an API key is present, and what a sandbox would send. Make the edit yourself, run the agent, then call signafaide_verify. For a snippet in a language and framework you name, without reading any project, use signafaide_quickstart instead.

directory.description: Path of the project to work on: the folder the MCP server was started in, or one below it. Default: that folder.
